source_record.source_detail_constraints: Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithfully enhance only the existing complete painted-game UI illustration. Image1 is exact historical original full48x48 RGBA. Image2 is the same complete storedRGB enlarged only by nearest-neighbor. Keep entire square UV canvas, exact source normalized contour positions, orientation, source count, shape, relative scale and local brightness/palette hierarchy. Authoritative complete original alpha is restored separately. Preserve source soft game paint, gentle finer painted tone at original scale, not new physical detail. Exactly TWO existing rounded oval-like painted forms: large front form diagonally descending from upper-left toward lower-right, small rear form nearly vertical at upper-right. Preserve original slight overlap/dark gap, rim width and the faint original dark curved trailing stroke toward lower-right. Approximate native footprints: large form x8..34,y13..35; smaller form x25..37,y8..24. Exact phase and silhouettes are defined by full reference, never adjust them to these approximate boxes. Preserve original dark top/left backdrop and bottom/right shadows. These are painted shapes: do not invent a realistic jewelry product, embossed dog tags, stamped letters, engraved marks, holes, new chain/cord, rings, screws or loops. Source bright codec samples are existing shading, not new hardware or texture grain. No new frame, background scene, bevel relief, sharp edges, photographic metal, glossy white highlights, brighter cores, rust, scratches, cloth grain, speckles, text or ornament. No crop/padding/rotation/repack/canvas replacement/registration. Gentle soft painted shading only. Intended production192x192. No comparison/labels. Color enabled Character Panel source. Preserve original muted warmgray/taupe forms and soft cool dark blue/teal upper-left backing. Larger form has restrained pale gray rim at source upper/right edge, smaller form has muted warmgray top; no bright chrome material or brighter reflections. Keep existing dim dark lower-right stroke faint and all local tonal relationships.

reference_recipe.operations: Whole source storedRGB nearest16 only; no crop/padding/registration/unpremultiply. Entire generated RGBA Lanczos192x192; entire originalA restored, native-encoding pure global scalar only.
